blocks.content: Small や, ゆ, よ combine with a preceding consonant + i kana to form a single blended syllable. The i vowel disappears and the two characters collapse into one sound.

lines: [consonant + i kana] + **ゃ / ゅ / ょ** → one syllable, not two

rows.one syllable: 4 mora: びょ・う・い・ん

blocks.content: びょういん (hospital) and びよういん (beauty salon) are frequently confused : the first has a small よ (one syllable), the second has a full-size よ (two syllables). The written distinction is crucial.
